milestones.title: Repo scaffold and version control
milestones.expected: Git hooks, setup scripts, status tracker, README, AGENTS.md and CODEX_PROMPT.md are in the repo.
milestones.note: Scaffolded before any app code exists.

milestones.title: Core DSP (no audio hardware needed)
milestones.expected: core/: OutputChannel (ring buffer, delay, drift control, crossfade jump, gain), chirp + matched-filter estimator, resampler wrapper, channel-mode mixing, CI workflow. Unit tests green on Linux and Windows.
milestones.note: Core DSP, unit tests, CI workflow, and shared TODO checklist complete

milestones.title: Audio backends
milestones.expected: backends/: AudioBackend interface, FakeBackend (virtual clocks, latencies, mic) and WasapiBackend (PyAudioWPatch: device listing, source capture, 2 render streams, mic capture).
milestones.note: Fake backend tests pass; WASAPI adapter needs Windows audio verification

milestones.title: Engine and CLI
milestones.expected: Engine wiring (source -> per-output resample -> OutputChannel -> render), keep-alive, idle-source handling, CLI devices/run. 10-minute simulated drift test passes.
milestones.note: Simulated engine and CLI pass; real audio requires Windows endpoint verification

milestones.title: Auto-calibration
milestones.expected: Calibration state machine and CLI calibrate. Simulated error under 1 ms across the test matrix; clear failure reasons (silent mic, dead speaker, low SNR).
milestones.note: Simulated chirp calibration passes; real microphone and speakers require verification

milestones.title: Tkinter GUI
milestones.expected: Device pickers, per-speaker volume/mute/delay/mode, Start/Stop, Calibrate with progress, level meters, status bar, saved settings.
milestones.note: Flask web dashboard complete; Tkinter replaced by Flask (deviation in NOTES.md); GUI smoke tests pass; real Windows audio UI needs hardware test

milestones.title: Packaging and hardware docs
milestones.expected: PyInstaller build script, docs/HARDWARE_TEST.md, docs/NOTES.md (unverified Windows assumptions), README usage section finished.

milestones.title: Real-hardware verification
milestones.expected: You run H1-H9 on the Windows laptop with the Flip 7 and Charge 4 and record results with status.py hw.
milestones.note: Only you can do this one.

milestones.title: Stretch goals (optional)
milestones.expected: N speakers, auto-reconnect on Bluetooth drop, tap-to-nudge sync, saved presets per speaker pair.

hardware_checks.check: Both speakers show up as outputs, using the Stereo endpoint (not Hands-Free).
Source capture works (virtual cable or chosen loopback) and the level meter moves.
Audio plays on both speakers at once with no feedback loop.
30 minutes of playback with no dropouts or crackle.
Calibration succeeds in a quiet room and agrees with by-ear tuning within 10 ms.
Calibration works with the laptop mic (if it fails, try disabling mic enhancements/echo cancellation).
Moving the delay slider is click-free.
Still in sync after 60 minutes (listen with a click track).
Turning a speaker off and on does not crash the app.
